verdict: GREEN — surgical Enter+Escape+autoFocus heal applied per L5.3-F-02 owner-recommended pattern (12 LOC body, no §7 conflict, sentinel extended +4 assertions, 37→41 GREEN)
verdict_rationale: Component lifecycle, race contracts (K2-HEAL-01 typed exception + IdempotencyKeyMiddleware double-tap protection + 409 not-cached), edge-input parsing (.50, very-large, comma-tolerant), 4 mode interactions, switch CASH↔CARD preservation, and 5 existing data-testid hooks all verified clean at HEAD. The only previously-open L5.3 friction (F-02 — no Enter on receivedInput, no Escape, no auto-focus) is now closed by the surgical 12-LOC heal applied in this report. Latent watcher race (P3) and 0-total loyalty path (P3 expected-behavior) documented as observations — no heal needed.

mounted.before_heal: ABSENT — component had NO mounted() hook. Only the order watcher (immediate:true) fired on prop arrival.
mounted.after_heal: Installs document-level Escape keydown listener via document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onEsc) — mirrors KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:189-204 pattern. Listener is permanent for the SFC lifetime because PosComponent.vue always renders <PosCounterCollectModal> in its template (line 1299) — only the inner <div v-if='visible'> overlay toggles.

order_watcher.race_assessment: SAFE for current parent usage. PosComponent (L3052/L3066) only does null → order or order → null transitions, never order_A → order_B. If a future caller ever transitioned order_A → order_B mid-axios-POST, the watcher would reset submitting=false (line 302) → re-enable Confirm button mid-flight → double-submit risk. Documented as P3 latent watcher race — no heal applied (out of scope, would need either a 'guard submitting during transition' branch OR a parent contract that null-first-then-set is always followed).
before_heal_responsibilities: Pre-fill cashReceivedRaw with FR comma decimal (GOAL-D2 line 300)
Reset submitting=false (line 302) — see race note above
after_heal_responsibilities: All of the above PLUS this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.receivedInput?.focus() + select()) so the input auto-receives focus AND its content is selected (cashier can type-then-Enter without mouse hop)
order_watcher.nexttick_rationale: cc-cash-section is v-if='selectedMode===CASH'. The receivedInput ref does NOT exist before selectedMode IS CASH and the DOM updates. immediate:true fires before mount on first run — wrapping in $nextTick defers focus until after the DOM produces the input element.

beforeUnmount.after_heal: Removes document-level Escape keydown listener via document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onEsc). The arrow-/method-as-handler reference matches add/remove via this._onEsc property — no lost-reference bug.

guards: if (!this.visible || this.submitting) return — modal is permanently mounted by parent, so the handler is global; the visibility guard ensures it's a no-op when no order is being collected. The submitting guard prevents an Escape press during a 200/409 in-flight POST from triggering onCancel mid-await.

emits.confirmed: Emitted on 2xx persist (line 408) with payload { orderId, mode, modeInt, received, total }. Parent (onCounterCollectConfirmed) clears counterCollectOrder + triggers loadKioskCashOrders + loadActiveOrdersStats + loadReadyOrders refresh.
emits.cancel: Emitted by: (a) overlay self-click (line 40), (b) close X button (line 56), (c) bottom cancel button (line 160), (d) Escape keydown (NEW — _onEsc handler), (e) typed-409 K2-HEAL-01 catch branch (line 436). Parent (onCounterCollectCancel) clears _collecting per-row guard + nulls counterCollectOrder.

CASH.ui_atoms: MONTANT REÇU input (receivedInput) + PosV5Numpad + cashChange rendu calc (visible when > 0) + cashShort alert (visible when received < total AND received > 0)
CASH.confirm_gate: canConfirm requires cashReceivedNumber >= orderTotal AND orderTotal > 0 (line 274). Backend (PaymentService.php:315-319) also enforces server-side — client-side guard avoids 422 round-trip + confusing toast.
CASH.edge_pre_heal: Cashier had to mouse-click ✓ Confirmer after typing — no Enter-to-confirm.
CASH.post_heal: @keyup.enter=onConfirm now bound on receivedInput. Auto-focus + select-all on modal open.

CARD.ui_atoms: Single mode-hint paragraph (cc_mode_card_hint). NO extra input.
CARD.confirm_gate: canConfirm requires orderTotal > 0 only (line 278). Backend allows received=null for non-cash (PaymentService.php L247).
CARD.behavior: Single-tap on mode tab + single-tap on Confirmer suffices. Submit sends received=null + note='Encaissement borne CARD (SSOT modal)'.

switch_CASH_to_CARD.state_preservation: selectedMode flips to CARD (line 310). cashReceivedRaw STAYS (not reset) — so if cashier flips back to CASH the value is preserved. cc-cash-section is hidden by v-if so the input is not visible during CARD/MOBILE/TICKET.
switch_CASH_to_CARD.phase_H_finding_check: Phase H (H2-HEAL-01) addressed the silent-409 problem; the state-preservation on mode switch was not regressed — verified at HEAD line 308-317.

switch_CARD_to_CASH.behavior_line_313: setMode rehydrates cashReceivedRaw to FR-comma pre-fill IF the field is empty OR parses to <= 0 (covers the numpad C clear case). The condition '(cashReceivedRaw === "" || Number(replace(",", ".")) <= 0)' correctly catches both '' and '0' edge cases.

edge_inputs_hunt.case: Empty cashReceivedRaw + click Confirm in CASH mode
edge_inputs_hunt.result: BLOCKED by canConfirm (line 274) — cashReceivedNumber=0 < orderTotal → returns false → Confirm button :disabled. onConfirm has additional double-gate (line 359) so even direct method invocation is rejected. SAFE.

Number.isFinite(parseFloat('1234567890.50'))=true → cashReceivedNumber=1234567890.5. cashChange computes correctly. CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (line 636) keeps display clean. canConfirm enforces >= orderTotal so a billion-euro receipt for an 8,50€ order goes through (cashier's prerogative).
parseFloat('.50') === 0.5 — works. Underwater for typical orders so canConfirm blocks the submit.

String(...).replace(',', '.') only replaces the FIRST comma. So ',,,,' → '.,,,' → parseFloat returns NaN → cashReceivedNumber=0 → canConfirm=false → CASH path blocked. CARD/MOBILE/TICKET unaffected. Acceptable behavior — cashier would visually see the multiple commas and Confirm button disabled.
edge_inputs_hunt.verdict: OBSERVATION (P3) — could be made stricter via .replace(/,/g, '.') if D2-adjacent decision wanted; NOT in M-POS-2 scope, deferred.

edge_inputs_hunt.result: canConfirm requires orderTotal > 0 (line 274 AND line 278) — 100%-discounted orders are BLOCKED from confirming through counter-collect. This is CORRECT V1 behavior: those orders should auto-PAID upstream by the loyalty redemption flow itself, not pass through cash counter-collect. PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment would also reject (assertCounterDeferredOrder asserts payment_method=COD + payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER). H2-HEAL-04 TTC-tax-bug context: per session memory, the TTC tax bug was fixed upstream — counter-collect itself is correct.

race_condition_audit.before_heal: submitting flag (line 374) flips true synchronously inside onConfirm BEFORE the axios.post await. 2nd click's onConfirm checks `this.submitting` (line 359) and returns immediately. Button :disabled='submitting' (line 167) provides UI-level guard.
race_condition_audit.middleware_layer: If somehow a 2nd POST escapes the JS guard, IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php scopes the X-Idempotency-Key by (branch_id, user_id, sha256(key)). Same orderId + modeInt + minuteBucket → SAME key → first POST cached 2xx, second POST waits via waitForCompletion (up to idempotency.race_wait_ms ~1500ms) and replays the cached 2xx. SINGLE DB::transaction, SINGLE fiscal_sequence_no, SINGLE audit row, SINGLE OrderPaidAtCounter dispatch.
race_condition_audit.verdict: TRIPLE-DEFENSE: button :disabled + this.submitting guard + middleware idempotency cache. SAFE.

race_condition_audit.before_K2_HEAL_01: Cashier B silently received 200 + OrderDetailsResource → modal toasted phantom 'cash_drawer_opened_simulation' → operational defect (till double-count risk).
race_condition_audit.after_K2_HEAL_01 (HEAD): Cashier B receives 409 + { error_code: 'payment_already_collected', order_id, message }. Modal onConfirm catch (line 429-438) branches on error_code (stable id), surfaces FR error toast 'Cette commande a déjà été encaissée par un autre caissier.' (with backend message fallback), sets submitting=false, emits cancel. Parent Q10 panel refreshes, already-paid row disappears.
race_condition_audit.service_layer: PaymentService.php:278-310 — same-cashier replay still preserved (V5.5 sister guard, lines 292-298), different-cashier OR unknown-collector → typed PaymentAlreadyCollectedException with collectedByUserId from audit_logs row + collectedAt from its created_at.
race_condition_audit.sentinel: tests/Feature/Payment/PosCounterCollectRaceProtectionSentinelTest.php — 4-test PHPUnit RefreshDatabase suite verifying service-level typed exception + same-cashier replay no-op + route-level 409 + negative-control (no 200, no OrderDetailsResource).

race_condition_audit.behavior: axios throws → onConfirm catch path (line 415). NOT the K2-HEAL-01 typed 409 branch (line 429) — falls through to the generic alertService.error(msg) at line 440 with err.response.data.message || $t('label.encaisser_failed'). submitting=false at line 441 → cashier can retry. Modal stays open (NOT auto-closed) because emit('cancel') not fired on network errors — preserves cashier context.
race_condition_audit.idempotency_replay: If the original POST actually committed on backend but the response was lost in network → cashier retries → same X-Idempotency-Key (same minuteBucket) → middleware replays cached 2xx → success path runs cleanly. If the retry crosses a minute boundary → DIFFERENT key → middleware does NOT replay → POST hits service → service finds payment_status=PAID for same user → returns 200 no-op via V5.5 sister-guard (lines 292-298) → modal success path runs cleanly. Either way: no double-charge, no fiscal-sequence gap.
race_condition_audit.verdict: OK — graceful UX retry + idempotency safety.

Refund is handled by RefundComponent + the X3 refund flow (M-POS-5 agent territory). counter-collect modal POSTs to /admin/pos/counter-collect/{order}/confirm only — never to a refund endpoint.
race_condition_audit.verdict: N/A — out of scope for M-POS-2.
